{{Vanilla|Deepslate}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Deepslate''' is the hard stone that makes up the Overworld below Y=0. As in vanilla ''Minecraft'', it drops cobbled deepslate when mined. In [[Matcha Flavoured]], cobbled deepslate is fired back into deepslate in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] rather than a furnace, and a wooden pickaxe breaks it without dropping anything.

== Obtaining ==
=== Breaking ===
Deepslate and cobbled deepslate need a pickaxe other than a wooden one: the pack's wooden pickaxe gets nothing from deepslate, cobbled deepslate or polished deepslate.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/non_mineable/wood.json}}</ref> A tool with the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] tool intrinsic smelts cobbled deepslate as it is mined, so it drops deepslate.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/cobbled_deepslate.json}}</ref>

=== Smelting ===
{{Recipes}}
Cobbled deepslate is fired into deepslate in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] ({{Value|Deepslate|cook_time|station=Mud Kiln}}); the vanilla furnace recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/kiln/deepslate.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
The [[Mason]] sells 2 [[Bulk blocks|bulk deepslate]] for 1 [[obol]] at the apprentice level; each unpacks into 64 deepslate.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/mason/2/bulk_deepslate.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
Cobbled deepslate, like cobblestone, can be blasted into [[gravel]]. Four cobbled deepslate make 4 polished deepslate, the main ingredient of the [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]]; see [[Progression]]. Deepslate can also be fired into polished deepslate in a mud kiln ({{Value|Polished Deepslate|cook_time|station=Mud Kiln}}), one block for one.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/kiln/polished_deepslate.json}}</ref> Two cobbled deepslate slabs craft back into a cobbled deepslate block. Picking up cobbled deepslate unlocks both recipes, along with the kiln recipe for deepslate.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/cobbled_deepslate_from_slabs.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/cobbled_deepslate.json}}</ref>
